# Drone TikTok Real-Motion Scene Plan V3

## Scene 1
- Name: Hook
- Duration: 0.0s - 3.5s
- Purpose: Stop the scroll with a beginner-pain opener
- Visual: Fast cinematic close shot of the foldable black drone body, front lights, and built-in screen remote waking up
- On-screen text: Want a drone that feels easier to start?
- Voiceover: Want a drone that feels easier to start?

## Scene 2
- Name: Takeoff
- Duration: 3.5s - 7.5s
- Purpose: Show immediate action and remove setup friction
- Visual: The drone lifts off smoothly from open ground while the built-in screen remote is visible in the operator's hand
- On-screen text: No phone setup. Just take off.
- Voiceover: No phone setup. Just use the screen remote and take off.

## Scene 3
- Name: Hover
- Duration: 7.5s - 11.5s
- Purpose: Sell stability and beginner confidence
- Visual: The drone hovers in place at chest height, clean background, slight camera orbit
- On-screen text: Stable hover. Beginner-friendly feel.
- Voiceover: Hold a stable hover,

## Scene 4
- Name: Dual Camera Switch
- Duration: 11.5s - 15.5s
- Purpose: Show angle variety and remote control feature
- Visual: Quick switch between front camera view and lower-angle view, with a subtle nod to the 90-degree adjustment shown in the product art
- On-screen text: Dual cameras. Switch angles fast.
- Voiceover: switch angles fast, and keep the view right in your hands.

## Scene 5
- Name: Remote Operation
- Duration: 15.5s - 20.5s
- Purpose: Prove ease of control
- Visual: Close-up of thumbs on the LCD remote, with one-click takeoff/landing, emergency stop, and playback-style controls visible around the screen
- On-screen text: Screen remote control
- Voiceover: Dual cameras and beginner-friendly controls make the first flight feel simpler.

## Scene 6
- Name: CTA
- Duration: 20.5s - 25.0s
- Purpose: Close with product desire and action
- Visual: Hero shot of the full kit: drone, screen remote, two batteries, carry case, spare propellers, prop guards, and accessories, with a final airborne beauty pass
- On-screen text: Tap to shop now
- Voiceover: If you want a ready-to-fly drone kit without extra setup friction, tap to shop now.
